country: International (six continents; ERS conference, Milan, Italy)

links.outcome: Bronchoscopist performance with versus without AI guidance on a phantom: segments inspected, structured progressions, time
links.effect: With AI guidance: +6.0 segments inspected (p<0.001), +5.2 structured progressions (p<0.001), +72 s procedure time (p<0.001); significant in novices, intermediates and experienced.
links.quote: AI guidance caused the participants to inspect more segments (mean difference, paired t-test: +6.0 segments, p<0.001), perform more structured progressions (+5.2 progressions, p<0.001) and spend more time on the procedure (+72 s, p<0.001) compared to their standard procedures.

unlisted_practices: AI-guided bronchoscopy used as a training and guidance aid, with effects compared across operator experience levels

screen.reason: Randomized crossover simulation trial assessing an AI-guided bronchoscopy system compared to standard bronchoscopy without testing a specific organizational deployment practice or safeguard.
